FALLBACK browser, signed out of every account. It shares no session, cookie, or login with the user, so it can only reach public pages — anything behind their sign-in (ad manager, CMS admin, analytics, dashboard) stops at the login wall. Prefer the `browser` tool, which drives the user's own signed-in Chrome and is what they watch; use this only when that is unavailable and the page is public. Never write a task that assumes the user is already signed in. Runs one bounded task behind exact approval; no arbitrary provider options; never blind-retried.

input_schema.description:
